subject: Re: Gate and plant
text:
Hello,

Thanks for your note. I hear you. I apologize. I did not realize the gate had been left open. I will be more careful from today. The dog is back inside. She is friendly, but very quiet. I will keep the latch checked. If it helps, I can water your plant while you travel. It is a small favor. Please call if the plant needs a second round. I value having a calm street. Sorry again. I appreciate your patience too. We can fix this easily.

Best wishes,
